class.name: MaszynaMoverRailVehicleUniversalController
class.description: [RailVehicleUniversalController] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleUniversalController].

members.member: [code]UCList[/code] The controller's position table. Each item's index corresponds to the position number (column A in the wiki table), starting from 0.
